title: Projection vocabularies

dataset.name: Any global field: Blue Marble on the warp side (ortho-cog-viewer default), CMIP6 HadGEM3-GC31-HM tas on the cell side (gridlook's default)

left.label: warp: ortho-cog-viewer: proj4js, omerc centred, interrupted Goode, tpers

right.label: cell: gridlook (d3-geo and d3-geo-projection, globe plus flat views)

gap: Shared ground; the vocabularies differ. d3-geo gives gridlook many named projections but no PROJ strings or EPSG codes beyond 3857; proj4js gives the warp side PROJ strings and a resolver, but the interrupted and oblique presets are hand-added.
bridge: proj-wasm as a shared resolver on an unknown-code miss, so both shells can accept a PROJ string or EPSG code and fall back to the same definition authority.
